feature_name: Update Linter Rules to Use Global Configuration
description: Modify three specific linter rules to check the 'globals' configuration entry instead of directly accessing environment settings. This change prepares the codebase for a future refactoring where environment settings will be resolved into globals before reaching the linting context.
functional_requirements: Update the 'no-undef' rule to check the 'globals' configuration entry when determining if a variable is defined
Update the 'no-extend-native' rule to check the 'globals' configuration entry when determining which globals are available
Update the 'no-constant-binary-expression' rule to check the 'globals' configuration entry when determining which globals are available
Ensure all three rules no longer directly access environment settings from the linting context
Add test coverage to verify the rules correctly use the 'globals' configuration
